family: Popular automated/bot and indicator strategies and their actual tested results

specs.name: Intraday noise-area momentum breakout (Zarattini-Aziz-Barbon / Quantitativo ES-NQ replication), 1-minute band stop-orders with band-trailing exit
specs.instruments: MNQ (best per Quantitativo), MES; MGC optional with pit-session mapping (08:20 open, 13:30 close, entries 08:25-12:30, flat 13:25)
specs.evidence: EQ 4. Quantitativo 2010-Jan 2025 with $0.85+$1.40/side and 0.25 tick/side slippage: ES L=14 2%-vol 8.1%/yr Sharpe 0.91 DD 24% win 36% payoff 2.09; ES L=90 16.8%/yr Sharpe 1.25 DD 21%; NQ L=90 24.3%/yr Sharpe 1.67 DD 24% win 38% payoff 2.25 (+6 bps/trade); portfolio 22.4%/yr Sharpe 1.57 DD 15%, 65% positive months, worst month -6.6%. SPY paper 2007-24 19.6%/yr Sharpe 1.33. Flat 2010-2017, edge 2018-2025, highly sensitive to slippage. Only strategy in the family with real after-cost ES/NQ 1-min evidence.
specs.data_gap: Paper's VWAP trailing-stop variant needs volume: this spec uses the base variant (crossed band = trailing stop), no volume needed. Vol-targeted sizing (2-3% target, 4-8x cap) replaced by Lucid micro sizing from the Monte Carlo plus an ATR hard stop. Note: trend_momentum__noise_area (30-min steps, market entries) exists separately; keep both ids.
specs.pseudocode:
PARAMS: lookback=14 (paper; 90 per Quantitativo), vm=1.0, entry_start='09:35', last_entry='15:00', flat='15:55', hard_stop_atr=0.5, trail='none'|'atr', max_trades=4, long_only=False
PRE (per session d, RTH 1-min bars 09:30<=tod<16:00): D=daily_bars(rth_only); O930[d]=D.open; prev_close[d]=D.close.shift(1); atr[d]=ATR14d[d]
  move[d,t]=|close(bar tod t)/O930[d]-1| for every RTH tod t; M=pivot(move) rows=day_id cols=tod
  sigma[d,t]=M.rolling(lookback,min_periods=lookback).mean().shift(1)[d,t]   # strictly days<d
  UB[d,t]=max(O930[d],prev_close[d])*(1+vm*sigma[d,t]); LB[d,t]=min(O930[d],prev_close[d])*(1-vm*sigma[d,t])  (known before bar t opens; round UB up/LB down to tick)
  skip day if sigma or atr NaN
STATE MACHINE per session over 1-min bars i with entry_start<=tod[i]<last_entry; pos=0; n=0:
  t=tod[i]; U=UB[d,t]; L=LB[d,t]
  if pos==0:
    if n>=max_trades: break
    up=high[i]>=U; dn=(low[i]<=L) and not long_only
    if not(up or dn): continue
    side = up&!dn ? +1 : dn&!up ? -1 : ((U-open[i])<=(open[i]-L) ? +1 : -1)   # both touched: side nearer the open
    level = side>0 ? U : L; hard=max(hard_stop_atr*atr[d], 4 ticks)
    place(i, side, entry_px=level, kind='stop', valid_bars=1, stop_px=level-side*hard [, trail_pts=hard, trail_act_pts=hard if trail=='atr'])
    pos=side; ep=level; sp=level-side*hard; n+=1
    if (side>0 and low[i]<=sp) or (side<0 and high[i]>=sp): pos=0   # mirror engine entry-bar stop check
  else:
    hard stop mirror: long stopped if low[i]<=sp, short if high[i]>=sp -> pos=0; continue
    band-trailing exit on 1-min close (re-entry into noise area): if pos>0 and close[i]<U: exit_at(i+1,+1); pos=0; skip bar i+1
                                                                 if pos<0 and close[i]>L: exit_at(i+1,-1); pos=0; skip bar i+1
    (reversal re-tested by the machine from bar i+2; paper allows reversals)
SESSION: set_session(entry_start,last_entry,flat); max_trades_day=max_trades; daily_loss_stop=1.0x block (MES $60/MNQ $80/MGC $80 per micro); daily_profit_stop=1.5x block (MES $180/MNQ $240/MGC $240)
specs.params_grid: lookback {14, 90}; vm {1.0, 1.5}; entry_start {09:35, 10:00}; trail {none, atr}; max_trades {2, 4} = 32 combos. Fixed: hard_stop_atr 0.5, last_entry 15:00, long_only False (one extra long_only=True MNQ run). Walk-forward must include 2022 and 2023 H2.
specs.session_rules: Entries [entry_start, 15:00) ET on RTH 1-min bars; stop-order entries at the band (valid 1 bar, re-evaluated every minute); forced flat 15:55 ET; no overnight. Gold variant: entries 08:25-12:30, flat 13:25.
specs.risk_rules: Hard stop 0.5 x ATR14d per trade (ES ~$125-175/MES, NQ ~$200-300/MNQ) so the Lucid scan will settle at ~4-8 micros; max 2-4 trades/day; daily loss stop 1.0x block, daily profit stop 1.5x block (trend days are the $3k source); typical day +/-$300-900 per 10 MNQ so eval needs >=6-8 contributing days for the 50% consistency rule.

specs.name: Supertrend flip with prop-firm scaffolding (RTH window, fixed $ or line stop, kill switch, optional TWAP side filter); canonical always-in 10/3 is the filters-off corner
specs.bar_size: 5-min (ATR 14 / mult 2.5) and 15-min (ATR 10 / mult 3.0), RTH-only continuous series
specs.evidence: EQ 1 for the prop variant (vendor claim NQ 15-min 2024-26: 48-55% win, 2.0-2.5x payoff, 1-3 trades/day, no trade log). EQ 3 for the canonical flip: independent tests show 42% win / PF ~1.0 outside trends (Dow 30 5-min), Gold H4 PF 3.19 in 2024-26 rally vs 1.02 in 2022-23 (regime artefact), NQ daily 52.7% win CAGR 4.6%; multiplier outside 2.5-3.5 degrades sharply.
specs.data_gap: VWAP agreement filter needs volume -> filter='twap' uses session_vwap (TWAP, flagged approximation). News blackout not implemented (no event calendar in the data).
specs.pseudocode:
PARAMS: bar=5, atr_len=14, mult=2.5 (bar=15 -> atr_len=10, mult=3.0), filter='none'|'twap', stop_mode='line'|'fixed', stop_usd=75 per micro, max_stop_atr=0.5 (x ATR14d), entry_start='09:35', last_entry='11:30'|'15:00', flat='15:55', max_trades=3
PRE on B=resample(df1,bar,rth_only=True): hl2=(H+L)/2; up=hl2-mult*ATR(atr_len); dn=hl2+mult*ATR(atr_len)
  up_f[k]=close[k-1]>up_f[k-1] ? max(up[k],up_f[k-1]) : up[k]; dn_f[k]=close[k-1]<dn_f[k-1] ? min(dn[k],dn_f[k-1]) : dn[k]
  trend[k]=(trend[k-1]==-1 and close[k]>dn_f[k-1]) ? +1 : (trend[k-1]==+1 and close[k]<up_f[k-1]) ? -1 : trend[k-1]
  st_line = trend>0 ? up_f : dn_f; flip_up[k]=trend[k]==+1 and trend[k-1]==-1; flip_dn mirror; twap=session_vwap(B)
ENTRY: for k with a flip, B.tod[k] in [entry_start,last_entry), i=B.i_next[k]!=-1: side=+1/-1
  if filter=='twap' and (side>0 and close[k]<=twap[k] or side<0 and close[k]>=twap[k]): skip
  entry_ref=close[k]; stop_px = stop_mode=='line' ? st_line[k] : entry_ref-side*stop_usd/point_value; clamp |entry_ref-stop_px| to [2 ticks, max_stop_atr*ATR14d]
  FLIP PATTERN: exit_at(i,-side); place(i,side,stop_px); place(i+1,side,stop_px) (i+1 only if same session and tod<last_entry)
EXIT: opposite flip (exit_at), hard stop, flat 15:55; no target
SESSION: set_session(entry_start,last_entry,flat); max_trades_day=3; Lucid block dls 1.0x, dps 1.0x
specs.params_grid: bar {5, 15}; mult {2.5, 3.0}; filter {none, twap}; stop_mode {line, fixed}; last_entry {11:30, 15:00} = 32 combos. Fixed atr_len tied to bar (14/10), stop_usd 75, max_trades 3. Do not grid 7/2 scalping settings.
specs.session_rules: Entries [09:35, 11:30 or 15:00) ET on confirmed N-min bar closes, executed market at next 1-min open; forced flat 15:55 ET.
specs.risk_rules: Hard stop = Supertrend line or $75/micro, clamped to 0.5 ATR14d; max 3 trades/day; daily loss stop MES $60/MNQ $80 per micro (kill switch), daily profit stop MES $120/MNQ $160. Expect 35-45% win with 3-5 loser strings; drop if PF < 1.1 on 2023-2024.

specs.name: UT Bot Alerts (ATR trailing-stop flip, QuantNomad/Yo_adriiiiaan) session-filtered
specs.evidence: EQ 1. TradeSearcher aggregate of 105 community backtests: avg PF 1.0, avg max DD 65%; anecdotes only (EUR/USD 4H ~60% over 25 trades, BTC 15m 8/12); no ES/NQ test with costs. Popular a=2/c=1 on 5-min flips several times per hour in chop.
specs.data_gap: None (OHLC). Heikin-Ashi source option must stay OFF.
specs.pseudocode:
PARAMS: bar=5, a=1.0, c=10, entry_start='09:35', last_entry='15:00', flat='15:55', max_trades=3, max_stop_atr=0.5 (x ATR14d), tgt='none'|'rr2'
PRE on B=resample(df1,bar,rth_only=True), src=close: nLoss=a*ATR(c)
  stop[k] = (src>stop[k-1] and src[k-1]>stop[k-1]) ? max(stop[k-1],src-nLoss) : (src<stop[k-1] and src[k-1]<stop[k-1]) ? min(stop[k-1],src+nLoss) : (src>stop[k-1] ? src-nLoss : src+nLoss)
  buy[k]=src[k]>stop[k] and src[k-1]<=stop[k-1]; sell[k]=src[k]<stop[k] and src[k-1]>=stop[k-1]
ENTRY: for k with buy (side +1) or sell (side -1), tod in window, i=B.i_next[k]!=-1:
  entry_ref=close[k]; stop_px=stop[k]; clamp |entry_ref-stop_px| to [2 ticks, max_stop_atr*ATR14d]; tgt_px = tgt=='rr2' ? entry_ref+side*2*|entry_ref-stop_px| : NaN
  FLIP PATTERN: exit_at(i,-side); place(i,side,stop_px,tgt_px); place(i+1,side,stop_px,tgt_px)
EXIT: opposite UT signal (exit_at), hard stop, target, flat
SESSION: set_session(entry_start,last_entry,flat); max_trades_day=3; Lucid block
specs.params_grid: bar {5, 15}; a {1.0, 2.0}; c {6, 10}; tgt {none, rr2} = 16 combos. a=2/c=1 deliberately excluded.
specs.session_rules: Entries [09:35, 15:00) ET at next 1-min open after a confirmed N-min signal bar; flat 15:55 ET.
specs.risk_rules: Stop = UT trailing line at signal, clamped to 0.5 ATR14d; max 3 trades/day; Lucid daily loss/profit block. Expect negative expectancy after $2.30-3.80/trade on 5-min; drop if PF < 1.1.

specs.name: Chandelier Exit (everget) direction flip with optional EMA(200) side filter
specs.evidence: EQ 2. No published metrics for the flip system; as an EXIT in StockCharts' RSI(5) system the tighter 22x1 improved CAR and drawdown everywhere (SPY/QQQ/IJR 2000-2016). Same object as Supertrend/UT Bot.
specs.pseudocode:
PARAMS: bar=5, len=22, mult=3.0, ema_filter=200 (0=off), entry_start='09:35', last_entry='15:00', flat='15:55', max_trades=3, max_stop_atr=0.5
PRE on B=resample(df1,bar,rth_only=True): ls_raw=highest(close,len)-mult*ATR(len); ls[k]=close[k-1]>ls[k-1] ? max(ls_raw[k],ls[k-1]) : ls_raw[k]
  ss_raw=lowest(close,len)+mult*ATR(len); ss[k]=close[k-1]<ss[k-1] ? min(ss_raw[k],ss[k-1]) : ss_raw[k]
  dir[k]=close[k]>ss[k-1] ? +1 : close[k]<ls[k-1] ? -1 : dir[k-1]; flip_up=dir==+1 and dir[k-1]==-1; flip_dn mirror; e200=EMA(close,ema_filter)
ENTRY: for k with a flip, tod in window, i=B.i_next[k]!=-1: side
  if ema_filter>0 and ((side>0 and close[k]<=e200[k]) or (side<0 and close[k]>=e200[k])): skip
  entry_ref=close[k]; stop_px = side>0 ? ls[k] : ss[k]; clamp |entry_ref-stop_px| to [2 ticks, max_stop_atr*ATR14d]
  FLIP PATTERN: exit_at(i,-side); place(i,side,stop_px); place(i+1,side,stop_px)
EXIT: opposite dir flip (exit_at), hard stop, flat; no target
SESSION: set_session(entry_start,last_entry,flat); max_trades_day=3; Lucid block
specs.params_grid: bar {5, 15}; mult {1.0, 2.0, 3.0}; ema_filter {0, 200} = 12 combos. Fixed len 22.
specs.session_rules: Entries [09:35, 15:00) ET at next 1-min open after confirmed N-min flip; flat 15:55 ET.
specs.risk_rules: Stop = chandelier line at entry clamped to 0.5 ATR14d; max 3 trades/day; Lucid block. mult 1.0 = many small stop-outs (5%-win profile risk), mult 3.0 = $150+ stops per micro. Drop if PF < 1.1 on 2023-2026.

specs.name: RSI(5) dip-buy with Chandelier exit (StockCharts SystemTrader intraday translation; RSI(2)/RSI(14) grid points, daily SMA50/200 regime)
specs.bar_size: 5-min RTH-only continuous series; regime from daily RTH closes
specs.evidence: EQ 3 for the daily original (SPY/QQQ/IJR 2000-12..2016-12, $10 commission: SPY CE(22,1) var B CAR 4.8% 62% win DD -20.8%; QQQ CAR 6.1% 60% win DD -25.6%; IJR CAR 10.8% 83% win DD -12.6%, 80 trades; tighter exit better everywhere). Intraday translation untested. RSI(14) 30/70 on 1-/5-min tests 20-23% win (control cell).
specs.pseudocode:
PARAMS: bar=5, rsi_len=5, thresh={2:10,5:30,14:30}[rsi_len], variant='B'|'A', regime='sma50_200'|'none', direction='long_only'|'both', ce_len=22, ce_mult=1.0, stop_atr=1.5 (x ATR(14) on B), entry_start='09:45', last_entry='15:00', flat='15:55', max_trades=3, min_hold=1
PRE: B=resample(df1,bar,rth_only=True); r=RSI(close,rsi_len) (Wilder); ls,ss,dir=Chandelier(ce_len,ce_mult) on B; a=ATR(14) on B
  D=daily_bars(rth_only); s50=SMA(D.close,50).shift(1); s200=SMA(D.close,200).shift(1)
  long_ok[d]=regime=='none' or s50[d]>s200[d]; short_ok[d]=direction=='both' and (regime=='none' or s50[d]<s200[d])
ENTRY long (short mirrored with 100-thresh): k with tod in window, i=B.i_next[k]!=-1, long_ok[day(k)]
  variant B: r[k-1]<thresh and r[k]>=thresh (cross back above);  variant A: r[k-1]>=thresh and r[k]<thresh (cross below)
  entry_ref=close[k]; stop_px=entry_ref-stop_atr*a[k]; place(i,+1,stop_px=stop_px)  # market at next 1-min open
EXIT: for k'>entry bar with k'-entry_k>=min_hold and close[k']<ls[k'] (everget ratchet): exit_at(B.i_next[k'],+1). Hard stop. Flat 15:55. No fixed target (optional tgt {none, rr1}).
SESSION: set_session(entry_start,last_entry,flat); max_trades_day=3; Lucid block dls 1.0x, dps 1.0x
specs.params_grid: rsi_len {2, 5, 14}; ce_mult {1.0, 2.0, 3.0}; direction {long_only, both}; stop_atr {1.5, 2.5} = 36 combos. Fixed variant B, regime sma50_200, bar 5. One extra run variant A + regime none on MES.
specs.session_rules: Entries [09:45, 15:00) ET at next 1-min open after confirmed 5-min bar; flat 15:55 ET; regime uses only prior-day daily closes.
specs.risk_rules: Hard stop 1.5-2.5 x 5-min ATR(14); chandelier ratchet exit; max 3 trades/day; Lucid daily loss/profit block. Profile (60-80% win, small payoff) fits Lucid's many-small-green-days need; trend-day short-circuit risk mitigated by regime filter and hard stop.

specs.name: Hull Suite (InSilico) slope flip / price-cross HMA(40), session-filtered
specs.evidence: EQ 3 for slow version (Oxford Strat 42 futures 1980-2016, no costs: only lengths >500 viable, PF 1.10, DD 58%, rated C) and QuantConnect SPY 30-min HMA(40) cross (CAGR 5.45%, Sharpe 0.43, DD 9.3%, win rate 5% with P/L ratio 22.4): the profile that trips a $2,000 EOD-trailing DD then the consistency rule.
specs.pseudocode:
PARAMS: bar=15, len=55, mode='slope'|'cross', stop_atr=1.5 (x ATR(14) on B), entry_start='09:35', last_entry='15:00', flat='15:55', max_trades=3
PRE on B=resample(df1,bar,rth_only=True): HMA(n)=WMA(2*WMA(close,floor(n/2))-WMA(close,n), round(sqrt(n))); h=HMA(len); a=ATR(14)
  slope: up[k]=h[k]>h[k-2]; flip_up=up[k] and not up[k-1]; flip_dn=(h[k]<h[k-2]) and not (h[k-1]<h[k-3])
  cross: flip_up=close[k]>h[k] and close[k-1]<=h[k-1]; flip_dn mirror
ENTRY: for k with a flip, tod in window, i=B.i_next[k]!=-1: entry_ref=close[k]; stop_px=entry_ref-side*stop_atr*a[k]
  FLIP PATTERN: exit_at(i,-side); place(i,side,stop_px); place(i+1,side,stop_px)
EXIT: opposite flip (exit_at), hard stop, flat
SESSION: set_session(entry_start,last_entry,flat); max_trades_day=3; Lucid block
specs.params_grid: bar {5, 15, 30}; len {40, 55}; mode {slope, cross}; stop_atr {1.0, 2.0} = 24 combos.
specs.session_rules: Entries [09:35, 15:00) ET at next 1-min open after confirmed N-min bar; flat 15:55 ET.
specs.risk_rules: Stop 1-2 x N-min ATR(14); max 3 trades/day; Lucid block. Expect <30% win; drop fast if payoff does not cover $2.30-3.80 per trade.

specs.name: Hull Suite(55) + LSMA(25) cross 'best 1-minute scalping' (Myth-Busting #9), swing stop, 1:4 R
specs.evidence: EQ 1. YouTube claim; the automation script publishes no results. Counter-trend 1:4 R needs ~25% win to break even before costs.
specs.pseudocode:
PARAMS: bar=1, hull_len=55, lsma_len=25, swing_n=10, rr=4.0, adx_filter=0 (0=off, 25=on), entry_start='09:45', last_entry='15:00', flat='15:55', max_trades=4, max_stop_atr=0.3 (x ATR14d), min_stop_ticks=4
PRE on B (bar 1 = RTH 1-min bars; else resample): h=HMA(close,hull_len); hull_up[k]=h[k]>h[k-2]; ls=LSMA(close,lsma_len)=linreg endpoint; adx14=ADX(14)
ENTRY long (short mirrored): not hull_up[k] (Hull red) and ls[k]>h[k] and ls[k-1]<=h[k-1] and (adx_filter==0 or adx14[k]>adx_filter); tod in window; i=B.i_next[k] (bar 1: i=k+1)
  entry_ref=close[k]; stop_px=min(low[k-swing_n+1..k])-1 tick; clamp |entry_ref-stop_px| to [min_stop_ticks, max_stop_atr*ATR14d]; tgt_px=entry_ref+rr*(entry_ref-stop_px)
  place(i,+1,stop_px=stop_px,tgt_px=tgt_px)
EXIT: stop, target, flat 15:55 (no signal exit)
SESSION: set_session(entry_start,last_entry,flat); max_trades_day=4; Lucid block
specs.session_rules: Entries [09:45, 15:00) ET at next 1-min open; flat 15:55 ET.
specs.risk_rules: Swing stop clamped to [4 ticks, 0.3 ATR14d]; max 4 trades/day; Lucid block. On 1-min NQ the stop is often the cost ($2-4/MNQ); only 5-min cells are honest. Drop if PF < 1.1.

specs.name: Squeeze Momentum (LazyBear SQZMOM_LB exact): first squeeze-release bar, linreg momentum direction, KC-band stop
specs.evidence: EQ 2. Bitduke port ~12% DD on BTC/ETH 1H-4H (no win/PF); AAPL 3-min anecdote 38-50%; LuxAlgo: 'squeezes can fire into failed moves'. No ES/NQ after-cost test. Low signal frequency helps consistency.
specs.data_gap: None (LazyBear's version needs no volume; Carter's original volume confirmation omitted). Differs from trend_momentum__squeeze_breakout by exact LazyBear momentum, first-release rule and momentum-fade exit.
specs.pseudocode:
PARAMS: bar=5, bb_len=20, bb_mult=2.0, kc_len=20, kc_mult=1.5, mom_len=20, min_squeeze_bars=3, exit_mode='rr'|'mom_fade', rr=2.0, max_stop_atr=0.5 (x ATR14d), entry_start='09:45', last_entry='14:30', flat='15:55', max_trades=2
PRE on B=resample(df1,bar,rth_only=True): mid=SMA(close,20); sd=population stdev(close,20); bb_up/dn=mid+-2*sd
  ma=SMA(close,20); rangema=SMA(TR,20); kc_up/dn=ma+-kc_mult*rangema
  sqzOn=bb_dn>kc_dn and bb_up<kc_up; sqzOff=bb_dn<kc_dn and bb_up>kc_up; run[k]=consecutive sqzOn bars ending at k
  val=linreg(close-((highest(high,20)+lowest(low,20))/2+SMA(close,20))/2, 20, 0)
  fire[k]=sqzOff[k] and sqzOn[k-1] and run[k-1]>=min_squeeze_bars; side=val>0 and val>val[k-1] ? +1 : val<0 and val<val[k-1] ? -1 : 0
ENTRY: for k with fire and side!=0, tod in [entry_start,last_entry), i=B.i_next[k]!=-1: entry_ref=close[k]; stop_px=side>0 ? kc_dn[k] : kc_up[k]; clamp |entry_ref-stop_px| to [2 ticks, max_stop_atr*ATR14d]
  tgt_px = exit_mode=='rr' ? entry_ref+side*rr*|entry_ref-stop_px| : NaN; place(i,side,stop_px,tgt_px)
EXIT: rr: stop/target/flat. mom_fade: for k'>entry with (long) val[k']<val[k'-1] and k'-entry_k>=2: exit_at(B.i_next[k'],+1); stop; flat
SESSION: set_session(entry_start,last_entry,flat); max_trades_day=2; Lucid block
specs.params_grid: bar {5, 15}; kc_mult {1.5, 2.0}; exit_mode {rr, mom_fade}; min_squeeze_bars {3, 6} = 16 combos. Fixed rr 2.0, BB 20/2.0.
specs.session_rules: Squeeze release must occur with bar start in [09:45, 14:30) ET; market at next 1-min open; flat 15:55 ET.
specs.risk_rules: Stop = opposite KC band clamped to 0.5 ATR14d (ES 5-min ~$30-50/MES); max 2 trades/day; Lucid block. Keep only if it adds trades on days the ORB specs do not fire.

specs.name: Nadaraya-Watson envelope (LuxAlgo) endpoint non-repainting mode, band re-entry mean reversion to basis with ADX gate
specs.evidence: EQ 1. LuxAlgo: 'nothing suggests this envelope outperforms traditional band tools'; all viral hit rates come from the repainting mode; no independent test on any instrument.
specs.data_gap: None (OHLC) but MUST use endpoint (causal) estimate; repainting smoothing forbidden.
specs.pseudocode:
PARAMS: bar=5, h=8.0, mult=3.0, window=500, regime='none'|'adx25', stop_atr=1.0 (x ATR(14) on B), max_hold=24 bars, entry_start='10:00', last_entry='15:00', flat='15:55', max_trades=3
PRE on B=resample(df1,bar,rth_only=True): w(i)=exp(-i^2/(2*h^2)), i=0..window-1
  basis[k]=sum_i close[k-i]*w(i)/sum_i w(i)  (uses bars<=k only); mae[k]=SMA(|close-basis|,window)[k]*mult; upper=basis+mae; lower=basis-mae; adx14=ADX(14)
ENTRY long (short mirrored on upper): close[k-1]<lower[k-1] and close[k]>=lower[k]; regime ok (adx14[k]<25 if adx25); tod in window; i=B.i_next[k]!=-1
  entry_ref=close[k]; stop_px=entry_ref-stop_atr*ATR14(B)[k]; tgt_px=basis[k] (fixed; skip if not > entry_ref+2 ticks)
  place(i,+1,stop_px=stop_px,tgt_px=tgt_px,max_hold=max_hold*bar)
EXIT: target (basis), stop, max_hold, flat

specs.name: Renko brick-reversal scalp (bricks = k x ATR14d built from 1-minute closes, reset at 09:30; fills on real bars)
specs.bar_size: 1-minute closes -> Renko bricks of size_atr x ATR14d (NQ ~10-20 pts, ES ~2-4 pts)
specs.evidence: EQ 1. No independent after-cost test; vendor 'best settings based on data' article has no data; NinjaTrader support, EliteTrader and pine maintainers document Renko backtests fill at synthetic prices and are 'reliably flattering'.
specs.data_gap: FLAG approximation: exact bricks need tick data. Bricks form on 1-minute closes only (intra-minute brick-and-reverse invisible), reset each session at the first RTH close (no overnight phantom bricks), all fills at next real 1-min open + 1 tick. Label results as an approximation of tick Renko.
specs.pseudocode:
PARAMS: size_atr=0.05 (brick=size_atr x ATR14d rounded to tick, min 2 ticks), n_confirm=2, tgt_bricks=3, stop_bricks=2, ema_filter=0 (0=off; 20=EMA(20) of brick closes rising for longs), entry_start='09:40', last_entry='15:00', flat='15:55', max_trades=4
BRICK BUILDER per session d over RTH 1-min closes c[i] from the 09:30 bar: size=brick size for d; top=bot=c[first]; bricks=[]
  for each bar i: while c[i]>=top+size: push(+1, completed at bar i); bot=top; top+=size
                  while c[i]<=bot-size: push(-1, completed at bar i); top=bot; bot-=size
  brick_close = top of up bricks / bottom of down bricks; e20=EMA(brick_close,20) if ema_filter
ENTRY long (short mirrored): at 1-min bar i (tod in window) where the last n_confirm bricks are +1, the brick before them is -1, and those bricks completed after the previous entry/exit; (ema_filter: e20 rising)
  entry_ref=close[i]; stop_px=entry_ref-stop_bricks*size; tgt_px=entry_ref+tgt_bricks*size; place(i+1,+1,stop_px,tgt_px)   # next real 1-min open
EXIT: first opposite brick completing at bar j>entry: exit_at(j+1,+1); stop; target; flat
SESSION: set_session(entry_start,last_entry,flat); max_trades_day=4; Lucid block

specs.evidence: EQ 1. No results published; the script was built to test the YouTube claim. Three lagging trend tools in agreement = late, infrequent entries.
specs.pseudocode:
PARAMS: bar=5, ut_a=2.0, ut_c=6, stc=(80,27,50), stc_lo=25, stc_hi=75, hull_len=55, tgt='none'|'rr2', max_stop_atr=0.5 (x ATR14d), entry_start='09:35', last_entry='15:00', flat='15:55', max_trades=3

  long_ok[k]=s[k]<stc_lo and stc_up and hull_up and ut_state==+1; short_ok mirror (s>stc_hi, falling, hull down, ut_state -1)
  fire_long=long_ok[k] and not long_ok[k-1]; fire_short mirror
ENTRY: for k with fire, tod in window, i=B.i_next[k]!=-1: entry_ref=close[k]; stop_px=ut_stop[k]; clamp to [2 ticks, max_stop_atr*ATR14d]; tgt_px = tgt=='rr2' ? entry_ref+side*2*|entry_ref-stop_px| : NaN; place(i,side,stop_px,tgt_px)
EXIT: UT Bot opposite signal -> exit_at(B.i_next[k'],side); stop; target; flat
